gui.title_crashed_with_report: $CONFIG.text.modpack_name$ crashed and the Boss doesn't know yet
gui.title_crashed_without_report: $CONFIG.text.modpack_name$ crashed silently, no report — the Boss loves a mystery
gui.comment_under_title_pls_report: Game crashed? Don't panic. Message your Boss — herypank — in DMs. The Boss fixes everything, the Boss knows everything (almost).
gui.comment_under_title:
Press "$LANG.gui.upload_all_comment$" and send the generated message to $CONFIG.text.support_place$.
Describe what you were doing before the crash: the Boss is not a mind reader, though he tries.
gui.comment_under_title_cant_resolve: If the logs make no sense, don't suffer alone — write to $CONFIG.text.support_name$.
gui.comment_under_title_screenshot_notic: A screenshot of this window tells the Boss nothing. Links to the logs tell everything.
